text:
ashwin: Heads-up — billing flagged a potential overcommit in our GPU reservations for us-east-1. Utilization dropped to ~62% last month vs the 78% we modeled. Thinking we need a hedging plan before the next commit window.

maria: Oof that gap is bigger than I expected. Is the drop concentrated on specific families (p4d/p3) or across the board?

ashwin: Mostly p4d and p4de. p3 is steady. Looks like two customers shifted to smaller batch sizes and our auto-scale rules didn't downsize reservations fast enough.

kevin: Could be churn in the short seq workloads — prefix caching change last quarter might've reduced token counts. We should check per-customer consumption before touching commits.

finance-bot: FYI — current committed spend vs actual is ~16% over forecasted ROI. Renewal window opens in 10 days for a subset of our RI/SavingsPlan portfolio.

maria: Proposal: build a short playbook with 3 lanes — (1) exchange/modify convertibles for region/family we still need, (2) use 6–12m short-term SavingsPlan top-ups for spiky customers, (3) shift low-utilization capacity to Dedicated burst pools and instrument eviction.

ashwin: Agree. For (1) we can leverage convertible RI exchanges where allowed. We'll need a mapping csv for candidates. Example CSV columns I want: `reservation_id, instance_family, region, term_end, utilization_pct, suggested_action`

kevin: Also consider a small buffer of on-demand in eu-west-1 to avoid overcommitting there — capacity constraints are pushing some workloads to us-east and we pay cross-region egress. Hedging can reduce cross-region pressure.

maria: Actionable checklist I'm happy to own:
- generate per-reservation utilization report (by customer tag + family) — @kevin help with filters
- run exchange candidate scan and surface convertible vs standard impact — @ashwin to run with billing team
- propose short SavingsPlan buys for 6/12 months for volatile families and tag them as "hedge" in billing so finance can track
- draft runbook for moving low-utilization machines into a burstable Dedicated pool

ashwin: I'll start the exchange-candidate export. Running simple query now: `SELECT reservation_id, family, region, avg_utilization_30d FROM reservations WHERE avg_utilization_30d < 70`

kevin: I'll attach the per-customer usage slice. Also, one gotcha — exchanging convertible RIs may change pricing on older purchases; I'll include delta estimates.

finance-bot: Please include expected monthly delta post-exchange and a 3-month ROI estimate. Finance needs that for approvals.

maria: Quick sample CSV I'll populate and push to the shared drive:```
reservation_id,family,region,term_end,utilization_pct,suggested_action,notes
r-0abcd1234,p4d,us-east-1,2026-10-01,62,exchange->p4de,"Customer X reduced seq len"
r-0efgh5678,p3,us-west-2,2027-01-15,85,keep,"steady"
```

ashwin: Nice. One operational note: if we do a mid-term exchange we should coordinate with eng-sre to stagger applies so capacity and autoscaling rules don't flip unexpectedly. @sre-bot can you flag any scheduled scale events in the next 14 days?

sre-bot: Scheduled scale events in the next 14 days: auto-scale rolling update (us-east-1) on 1951237000, maintenance window (us-west-2) on 1951290000.

maria: Great — let's avoid the rolling update window. Timeline: 48h for reports, 72h to finalize candidate list, then finance sign-off. If approved, we do exchange ops in small batches over 7 days.

kevin: Sounds good. I'll start the per-customer slice now and drop the file in #eng-infra-reports.

ashwin: Thanks all — I'll ping when exchange CSV is ready. :thumbsup:
